verdict.rationale: GitBook versions and reviews content, not automations. AI-driven changes from the GitBook Agent or MCP clients can arrive as change requests, which can be reviewed, including with GitBook Agent. Version control and Git Sync give history and a path to revert, so the outputs of automations are versionable, reviewable and reversible. There is no evidence that the automations themselves (agent configurations, translation rules, integrations) can be versioned, reviewed or rolled back. Missing for 10: versioning of automation definitions or configs, review workflow for automation changes, documented rollback of automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
